thread:
maya: Triage alert: found an orphaned project-level Admin binding for svc-invoice-sync@redwood-prod on billing-prod. No PR or owner metadata. Need rapid owner lookup and risk assessment. @oncall pls ack. :eyes:

jamal: Acked. Which binding line? paste the exact IAM snippet if available.

maya: From IAM snapshot: `roles/editor` and also `roles/owner` -> `serviceAccount:svc-invoice-sync@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on `projects/billing-prod`. Audit event shows change 2026-02-14T22:09Z. Raw event: https://logs.internal/reports/510123-evidence (internal)

oli: Owner on an SA for billing-prod feels risky. Quick questions: has this SA been issuing keys or creating infra? Any recent deploys tied to it?

sasha: audits-bot assembled an evidence bundle and uploaded: https://s3.internal/audit-views/billing-svc-invoice-sync-510123.csv (IAM snapshot, KMS grants, recent token usage, and last-autorun entries).

audits-bot: auto-note: evidence bundle created for thread 5101230000. Contains policy delta, key grants, and 30d token histogram.

lina: I can scan deploy history — I see a ferment-job that ran 2026-02-15 which used this SA for a one-off migration. Owner might have been granted by an automation temporarily and never reverted.

jamal: KMS check: does the SA have cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter or keyAdmin on any customer or billing keys? If yes, we need immediate rotation planning.

maya: It has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on `projects/billing-prod/locations/global/keyRings/billing-keys/ck-invoice`. Decrypt logs show ~5 decrypts in last 14 days. Bundle contains decrypt timestamps.

oli: Proposal: 1) owners to respond in 12h. 2) if no owner, oncall to apply a temporary ACL removing Owner but retaining necessary roles (editor or custom minimal). 3) Jamal to draft key rotation + rewrap plan within 48h if KMS involved. 4) schedule a least-privilege sweep for billing-prod SAs next week.

jamal: I'll start rotation doc. Quick capture commands I ran to reproduce state:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy billing-prod --format=json > billing-iam-510123.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner")' billing-iam-510123.json
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ck-invoice --location=global --keyring=billing-keys --project=billing-prod
```

sasha: Evidence hygiene: attach any PR, ticket, or runbook that justifies the Owner grant. If none, mark as undocumented change and create a forensics card. Also snapshot token origination IPs.

maya: I searched infra PRs and deployment tickets — no explicit justification found. Marking as undocumented. Creating forensic task.

oncall: oncall here  acknowledged. I'll create INC-2026-5101 and page infra owners. If no owner confirmation within 12h I'll schedule the emergency ACL (12-18h window).

lina: I dug into automation logs — automation account deploy-cascade-bot applied IAM delta on 2026-02-14 but commit shows a retired machine user as the actor. I'll attach the trace to the bundle. Might be a forgotten automation.

oli: Weak provenance. Treat as orphan until proven otherwise. Action items + owners:
- Jamal: lead KMS rotation plan + impact matrix (48h).
- Oli: validate dependent jobs, cronjobs, and runbooks; list potential service-impact (24h).
- Sasha: finalize and upload audit bundle to INC-2026-5101; include token usage and KMS decrypt timeline (12h).
- Lina: continue automation provenance deep-dive and list any retired actors (12h).
- Oncall: create INC ticket and apply emergency ACL if no owner confirmed in 12-18h.

maya: Also remind product teams to check scheduled maintenance windows before we rotate keys. If rotation impacts billing reconciliation, we need SLA sync.

jamal: Noted. I'll include rollback steps and a preflight checklist in the rotation doc. Expect first draft in ~3h.

sasha: Small ask: when you apply ACL, prefer a custom role drop instead of full Owner removal to avoid accidentally breaking exporter jobs. Document the exact change and command used.

jamal: Command we plan for emergency demotion (example):
```
# snapshot, then remove specific binding
gcloud projects get-iam-policy billing-prod --format=json > before-iam-510123.json
# edit bindings locally to remove serviceAccount principal from roles/owner
gcloud projects set-iam-policy billing-prod edited-iam.json
```

oli: Good. Also add a temporary alert rule to surface any 5xx errors in exporter and reconciliation endpoints post-change.

maya: Thanks team. This thread is canonical for remediation coordination. I'll update INC-2026-5101 with links and mark for daily check-ins until resolved. :thumbsup:
